serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
'Nun' Shanice: Goku the second! Me and all of the liberated Priestbots of Vatican beat all of your cyborgs from Swiss Guard and bishops are being safely released from the dungeon! It’s over!
Goku the second: Girl, I don’t even know who you are…
Goku the second: If you really think some insignificant nun can stop me…{{wi}} you are wrong!
'Nun' Shanice: I’m not a nun actually.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I didn’t want to believe it, but my speech pattern recognition software has confirmed that Pope speaks like a bad guy.
Goku the second: Muahahaha! I fooled every bishop with my sweet words, but I always had to be careful around the likes of you, machine…
Goku the second: John Paul 202 was truly a great man… Because he spent his life in solitude, after his death no one is even close to understanding his Holy Code…
Goku the second: These stupid bishops never saw the sheer potential!!! 
Goku the second: Ahhh… I got a little hard there...
'Nun' Shanice: Ew… What a creep!
Goku the second: If you really think I will just… reveal my plan to you lot, you are deadly wrong...
Ecclesiasticalot FF: If you don’t want to tell us, we will just force you to do it.
Goku the second: HaHaHaHa! I want to see you try…
'Nun' Shanice: Wah! Why is the ground shaking!
Goku the second: By combining my GENIUS with the source code of Ecclesiasticalots I created the perfect weapon. Behold! My 50 meters tall mech with 12 miniguns, 6 canons and 2 plasma magnetic infrared sonic throwers…
